summary: Return flight delayed overnight by a strike
story: My flight home from Lisbon was delayed until the next day by an air traffic control strike. I stayed at an airport hotel and paid for meals and a taxi.

items.description: Taxi to the hotel and back

documents.name: Delay notice from Northwind Air
documents.content: Northwind Air flight NW 204 Lisbon to Leeds Bradford on July 9, 2026 was delayed 19 hours because of industrial action.

documents.name: Hotel receipt
documents.content: Hotel Tejo Airport. One night, July 9, 2026. Total 180.00.

summary: Checked suitcase lost on the way out
story: My checked suitcase never arrived in Barcelona and the airline declared it lost after three weeks. I am claiming the case and what was in it.

documents.name: Property irregularity report
documents.content: Northwind Air PIR BCN-NW-55102. One checked bag, not located after 21 days, declared lost.

documents.name: Receipts for the suitcase and clothes
documents.content: Suitcase 260.00. Clothes 400.00. Shoes 120.00.

summary: Laptop and headphones stolen from a hotel room
story: My laptop and headphones were taken from my hotel room in Kyoto while I was out. I reported it to the police the same evening.

documents.name: Police report
documents.content: Kyoto Prefectural Police report 2026-0806-311. Theft of a laptop and headphones from a hotel room.

documents.name: Receipts
documents.content: Laptop 1,400.00. Headphones 300.00.

summary: Treated at a clinic for a broken wrist
story: I fell on a coastal path and broke my wrist. A clinic in Chania set it in a cast and gave me painkillers.

documents.name: Clinic notes
documents.content: Chania Coastal Clinic. Patient Theo Lindqvist. Distal radius fracture, closed reduction, cast applied. Follow-up advised at home.

documents.name: Clinic invoice
documents.content: Treatment and cast 850.00. Medicine 70.00.

summary: Trip cancelled after a family bereavement
story: My father died a week before we were due to travel, so I cancelled the trip. The tour company kept the non-refundable balance.

documents.name: Tour company cancellation letter
documents.content: Atlas Trails confirms cancellation of booking AT-7731. The balance of 1,800.00 is non-refundable.

documents.name: Death certificate extract
documents.content: Certified extract confirming the death of the traveler's father on September 2, 2026.

story: My passport was stolen on a tram in Prague. I got an emergency travel document from the embassy to fly home.

documents.name: Police report
documents.content: Prague Police report 4471/2026. Passport reported stolen on April 6, 2026.

documents.name: Embassy receipt
documents.content: Emergency travel document 145.00. Photos 15.00.

story: My bag arrived two days after I did, so I bought clothes and toiletries to get by.

documents.name: Delayed bag report

documents.name: Receipts

summary: Flew home early because of a house fire
story: A fire damaged my home while I was away, so I flew back early to deal with it.

documents.name: Fire service report
documents.content: Durham Fire Service attended a fire at the traveler's home on October 8, 2026.

documents.name: Flight receipt
documents.content: One-way Vancouver to Newcastle 950.00.

summary: Overnight delay after a cancelled train
story: My train to the airport was cancelled and I missed the last flight, so I stayed the night.

story: Someone broke into the hire car and took my backpack and rain jacket.
